Maya (CSM): Flagging Stonebridge 12 - tokens down ~72% overnight. Their ML lead mentioned a short competitor eval in email. Need triage. :warning:
redwood-bot: [alert] account_usage_drop: Stonebridge (acct_1212) - 72% WoW drop. AlertID: UDF-1212-08
Dan (AE): Yikes. Who's our champion and any procurement notes?
Maya (CSM): Champion is Ava (ML lead). She said they started a 2-week pilot with "OtherAI" yesterday; no RFP yet. Procurement said cost sensitivity is real.
Ravi (SE): Telemetry quick snippet (tokens/day):```
2026-03-10: 34,900
2026-03-11: 36,100
2026-03-12: 11,000
2026-03-13: 9,200
2026-03-14: 7,000
2026-03-15: 4,300
```
Nora (CS Ops): Playbook: 1) 20m call in 24h to surface infra vs model reasons; 2) offer 72h env-parity bench with fixed infra; 3) send regression vs their golden prompts and small SLA/cost note. I'll schedule.
Dan (AE): I'll push a short env-parity credit and ask for competitor success metrics. Can someone pull the last 30-day prompt-set eval?
Ravi (SE): Pulled high-level diffs: retrieval-heavy prompts down ~18% accuracy vs baseline. I'll prepare a one-pager showing expected perf gains from prefix caching + pinned quant variant. Quick config we can flip during A/B:```
PATCH /v1/accounts/1212/config
{ "prefix_cache": true, "quant_variant": "q4_8bit" }
```
Maya (CSM): Action owners: Dan - lead outreach + commercial ask; Ravi - one-pager and repro recipe before call; Nora - book 20m and attach telemetry + eval link; Maya - prep renewal risk note for AM and flag exec escalation if they indicate replacement.
Nora (CS Ops): Booked 20m with Ava for 2026-03-16 09:00 PT. Invite includes telemetry, repro recipe, and proposed 72h parity bench steps.
Dan (AE): On the call I'll request written success criteria for the competitor pilot and permission for a 72h side-by-side where we control infra for our variant. If they refuse, ask for same-hardware run.
Maya (CSM): If they confirm competitor parity testing, escalate to Director CS for a QBR within 5 business days. Case# CS-1212-ENV_PARITY. Keep thread short for handoff.
redwood-bot: [note] alert acknowledged by Maya at 2026-03-15T13:07:12Z
Dan (AE): Will update after the 3/16 call. :thumbsup:
